sequence_metadata.description: Recommended implementation sequence considering dependencies, priorities, and efficient development workflow

implementation_sequence.title: Create Configuration Validation Module
implementation_sequence.rationale: Foundation for all operations; validates environment setup before any API calls

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Input Validation for Task Operations
implementation_sequence.rationale: Core validation logic needed before refactoring existing functions

implementation_sequence.title: Enhance Error Handling with Retry Logic
implementation_sequence.rationale: Critical infrastructure for reliable API communication; blocks most feature work

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Structured Logging System
implementation_sequence.rationale: Independent infrastructure task; can be done early to improve debugging for subsequent tasks

implementation_sequence.title: Create Database Schema Configuration Module
implementation_sequence.rationale: Independent infrastructure; makes system more flexible for different Notion setups

implementation_sequence.title: Refactor createTask with Enhanced Validation
implementation_sequence.rationale: Refactor existing critical function with new infrastructure; high priority

implementation_sequence.title: Refactor updateTask with Enhanced Validation
implementation_sequence.rationale: Refactor existing critical function with new infrastructure; high priority

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Task Retrieval Functionality
implementation_sequence.rationale: Core missing CRUD operation; needed for search and CLI

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Task Deletion/Archive Functionality
implementation_sequence.rationale: Complete basic CRUD operations; relatively simple implementation

implementation_sequence.title: Add Unit Tests for Validation Modules
implementation_sequence.rationale: Test foundation modules early to catch issues before building on them

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Task Search and Filtering
implementation_sequence.rationale: Advanced query functionality; builds on task retrieval

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Batch Task Creation
implementation_sequence.rationale: Valuable feature for bulk operations; builds on refactored createTask

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Batch Task Updates
implementation_sequence.rationale: Completes batch operations; builds on refactored updateTask

implementation_sequence.title: Implement Rate Limiting Protection
implementation_sequence.rationale: Important for production reliability; prevents API quota issues

implementation_sequence.title: Add Assignee Management Functionality
implementation_sequence.rationale: Completes the assignee feature that was stubbed in original implementation

implementation_sequence.title: Add Unit Tests for Core Operations
implementation_sequence.rationale: Test refactored and new operations; ensure reliability before CLI integration

implementation_sequence.title: Implement CLI Interface
implementation_sequence.rationale: User-facing interface; requires all core CRUD operations to be complete

implementation_sequence.title: Add Integration Tests
implementation_sequence.rationale: End-to-end testing with real Notion API; validates complete system

implementation_sequence.title: Create API Documentation
implementation_sequence.rationale: Document all completed features and APIs

implementation_sequence.title: Create Setup and Usage Guide
implementation_sequence.rationale: Final comprehensive documentation including CLI usage

sprint_1.name: Foundation and Core Infrastructure
sprint_1.goals: Establish core infrastructure for validation, error handling, and logging

sprint_2.name: CRUD Operations Enhancement
sprint_2.goals: Refactor existing operations and implement complete CRUD functionality

sprint_3.name: Advanced Features
sprint_3.goals: Add search, batch operations, rate limiting, and assignee management

sprint_4.name: CLI and Testing
sprint_4.goals: Build CLI interface and comprehensive test suite

sprint_5.name: Documentation and Release
sprint_5.goals: Complete all documentation and prepare for release

minimum_viable_product.description: Minimum set of tasks to achieve basic functional system
minimum_viable_product.rationale: MVP includes configuration, validation, error handling, and complete CRUD operations

notes.parallelization: Many tasks in early phases can be executed in parallel by different team members
notes.testing_strategy: Unit tests should be written alongside feature development, not deferred to end
notes.risk_mitigation: Start with high-priority infrastructure tasks (TASK-001, TASK-002, TASK-003) to avoid rework
notes.flexibility: Task order can be adjusted based on team priorities and available resources
